comments.author: @badgthom
comments.text: Thank you for creating these great videos. I have one question for you. Hypothetically speaking imagine that pool covers have yet to be invented.  I have this idea to put a retractable cover over a pool.  The thing is that I have multiple ways of doing this. I can use a retractable cover that rolls up or a cover that cantilevers over the edge of the pool by pulling it from one end.  If my invention is I created a cover that can be removed from a pool in multiple ways do I need a patent for EACH of those two ways.  The roll top and cantilever or would I be covered under the general pool cover by either way? How could I just patent it where no one else could create a cover on a pool that is removable or is that even possible. Thanks again!! I look forward to watching all your videos.

comments.author: @bobwatson1895
comments.text:
Hi John, I am looking forward to this video series. When do you plan on releasing the series?

I have drafted my ppa and have pretty much everything disclosed including great drawings. The thing I am struggling with is the Claims. I've heard it's nice to include at least one claim and some say don't bother with claims in a ppa. I know what claims I want however I'm afraid that by adding them I may have limiting language or write them wrong, if so can I correct/drop claims on a second ppa down the line?
